ai_generated_tags.description: The image depicts a modern urban kitchen/pantry with a U-shaped layout featuring built-in cabinets and open shelving. The cabinets have a metallic finish on the doors, complemented by light wood paneling on the lower sections, creating a contemporary design. The space utilizes a minimalist color palette with gray metallic, light wood, white walls, and beige marble flooring. This kitchen appears to be designed for functionality, typical of newer Indian residential spaces where traditional elements are often minimized in favor of a clean, efficient layout.
